description: States of each canvas screen the real app must reproduce. Each state has a fixture in e2e/fixtures/states/registry.ts and is captured by e2e/design/D-06-states.e2e.ts. A screen whose feature is not built yet is listed with `pending` (the change that adds it); it must gain states when that change lands.

states.description: Connected development console with a result grid
Production connection: read-only badge and red stripe
Table editor with one edited cell and the pending bar
New connection, network driver, General tab

MongoBrowser.pending: needs the nosql Docker stack: the design suite adds container-backed states on Linux

AppIcon.pending: the mark appears in Welcome and the toolbar; the icon itself is checked by the app-icon spec
